paths.description: Homepage catalogue, age acknowledgement, preferences, mobile layout, performance, security, discoverability, sustainability, and memory. Represents the primary landing/listing template.
Search results for nature. Represents search/listing/filter navigation and result-card presentation.
Account sign-in and empty submission. Represents authentication, forms, focus, labels, autofill, validation, and recovery.
Deliberately invalid URL. Represents HTTP/navigation failure recovery.

Authenticated account management, upload, payment/GOLD checkout, post-age-gate video playback, comments, and destructive/cancellation flows were not covered because they require credentials, payment, user data, or entering explicit playback; representative public and auth-entry templates were prioritised.

findings.summary: Theme is fixed rather than preference-driven.
findings.evidence: The default and emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark screenshots are byte-identical, while DOM/CSS inspection found no preference-driven theme switch.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() so browser chrome and surfaces follow the user preference.

findings.summary: Motion is not reduced when requested.
findings.evidence: The preference-conditioned capture remained identical and the account probe reported five running animations; the inspected CSS includes animated pulse/toggle transitions without a reduced-motion override.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap non-essential animation and transition declarations in no-preference and disable them under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Route and state changes use abrupt swaps.
findings.evidence: The CSS/API probe found no view-transition rules, and navigation among home, search, account, and error templates uses full-document swaps without a visual continuity cue.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-origin navigation with cross-document View Transitions and a no-animation fallback.

findings.summary: Persistent navigation does not react to scroll state.
findings.evidence: Desktop and mobile captures show fixed, dense chrome, while the CSS probe found no scroll timeline/container-state implementation.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a sticky header that reduces or clarifies itself after scrolling, with CSS scroll-state/container-query enhancement.

findings.summary: Navigation changes do not visibly guide attention.
findings.evidence: Search, account, and 404 captures switch templates abruptly; there is no transition, highlighted destination, breadcrumb, or focus cue tying the prior action to the new state.
findings.suggestedFix: Add destination focus management and a restrained directional transition or current-location cue.

findings.summary: The blocking age gate is an ad-hoc overlay rather than a semantic modal.
findings.evidence: DOM/CSS evidence identifies #disclaimer_background and #disclaimer_message divs; the probe found zero dialog, popover, or details elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the mandatory age gate as a dialog with a labelled title, contained focus, Escape policy, and explicit leave/continue actions.

findings.summary: Dense navigation and category chrome compete with content.
findings.evidence: The search first viewport contains two navigation rows, controls, filters, badges, and the blocking gate before the results; the mobile viewport also devotes substantial space to persistent chrome.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse secondary controls progressively, keep one clear primary navigation row, and reveal advanced filters on demand.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is viewport-only.
findings.evidence: The component/CSS probe found no @container rules, although reused search, account, header, and card components appear in different available widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Use container-type and size-aware component queries where cards, forms, and navigation are reused.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is missing on many controls.
findings.evidence: The account focus probe found outline:none and no box shadow on visible form controls and buttons; only the first logo links retained a UA outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible treatment and verify every interactive control through a keyboard focus walk.

findings.summary: Cold-load LCP is slow.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 6.8 s, FCP 3.7 s, and performance 0.68; the separate warm trace measured LCP 1.22 s, showing material condition sensitivity.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP resource, reduce blocking discovery chains, and validate cold-load field-like conditions.

findings.summary: Parser-blocking assets and weak image caching delay delivery.
findings.evidence: HAR found a VeryHigh parser stylesheet, a synchronous head script, several synchronous scripts, and ten large thumbnails without useful cache headers.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical scripts, inline only critical CSS, and serve immutable thumbnail URLs with useful cache headers.

findings.summary: Important controls and thumbnail links lack accessible names.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.71 and identified an unnamed close button plus unnamed menu and thumbnail links; the image audit found 98 of 100 images without alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Give icon controls explicit accessible names and ensure each linked thumbnail has meaningful link text or an accessible name; use empty alt only for decorative images.

findings.summary: Heading structure and keyboard focus are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The home recon found no h1; the account probe found repeated h2 headings, no main/nav landmarks, and outline:none on visible controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide one descriptive h1, semantic main/nav landmarks, a logical heading hierarchy, and visible :focus-visible states.

findings.summary: Mobile zoom is disabled.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed meta-viewport because the homepage declares maximum-scale=1.0 and user-scalable=no.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable=no, then verify reflow at 200% and 400% zoom.

findings.summary: Image assets lack dimensions and responsive delivery.
findings.evidence: The image audit found all 100 images without width/height attributes or srcset, 12 oversized images, and 100 legacy-format images.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve aspect-ratio/width/height and provide size-appropriate srcset/sizes with modern formats where supported.

findings.summary: The homepage has no canonical URL.
findings.evidence: The metadata probe returned no canonical link, although robots.txt permits the homepage and a sitemap index exists.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a self-referencing canonical URL and keep it consistent with sitemap and redirect behavior.

findings.summary: Share and entity metadata are absent.
findings.evidence: The homepage metadata probe found no Open Graph tags and no JSON-LD blocks despite the page representing a public media catalogue.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Open Graph/Twitter preview metadata and appropriate schema.org JSON-LD matching visible catalogue content.

findings.summary: Transport is HTTPS but key hardening headers are absent or weak.
findings.evidence: Header evidence found no HSTS or nosniff and a CSP that allows unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy HSTS and nosniff; migrate inline/eval execution to nonce/hash-based CSP directives and narrow allowed origins.

findings.summary: The observed sign-in route offers passwords and federated login but no phishing-resistant passkey option.
findings.evidence: The account screenshot shows password, Google, and X sign-in; the DOM/API probe found no WebAuthn/passkey affordance. No permission prompt fired on load.
findings.suggestedFix: Offer passkey registration and authentication alongside existing recovery paths.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policy coverage is incomplete.
findings.evidence: Headers evidence found no Permissions-Policy, no HSTS, no nosniff, and only legacy X-Frame-Options; Referrer-Policy remains no-referrer-when-downgrade.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrictive Permissions-Policy, modern Referrer-Policy, HSTS and nosniff, and express clickjacking defense with CSP frame-ancestors.

findings.summary: Most catalogue content is missing without JavaScript.
findings.evidence: Discoverability evidence fetched 130 KB of raw HTML but found only 29% rendered-word coverage; the rendered page is not an empty shell, yet most catalogue content is client-dependent.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render core catalogue labels and crawlable links, then progressively enhance interactions with JavaScript.

findings.summary: Empty sign-in submission provides no persistent, actionable error state.
findings.evidence: After activating Sign in with both fields empty, the captured page remained visually unchanged with no inline error summary or recovery instruction.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after submission, mark fields with aria-invalid, associate clear messages, focus an error summary, and preserve entered values.

findings.summary: Sign-in fields omit autocomplete tokens.
findings.evidence: The account probe reports empty autocomplete values for email and password fields.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=username and autocomplete=current-password, with appropriate tokens on registration fields.

findings.summary: The catalogue ships non-responsive legacy imagery.
findings.evidence: Image evidence found 100/100 images without srcset, 100 legacy PNG/JPEG resources, 12 oversized images, and 89 below-fold images without lazy loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, add srcset/sizes and dimensions, and lazy-load below-fold thumbnails.
